title: Score-Preserving Continual Lasso under Task Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.32708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual learning (CL) aims to learn from sequential tasks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting when historical data are no longer accessible. We study continual learning for high-dimensional sparse linear regression, where $\ell_1$ regularization creates a difficulty absent from continual ridge regression: that recursively reusing an $\ell_1$-penalized estimator can propagate earlier shrinkage and accumulate regularization bias across tasks. We propose score-preserving continual Lasso (SP-CL), which separates sparse estimation from state transmission by preserving the historical squared-loss score. Under squared loss, its cumulative estimator exactly recovers a full-history Lasso minimizer. When task coefficients coincide, it inherits the full-history sparse rate. For related task-specific coefficients, SP-CL uses a regularized current-task correction that leaves the transmitted state unchanged and attains the offline source-assist

translated_title: 任务偏移下的保得分持续Lasso
translated_abstract: 持续学习旨在从序列任务中进行学习，同时在历史数据不再可访问的情况下缓解灾难性遗忘。我们研究高维稀疏线性回归中的持续学习问题，其中 ℓ₁ 正则化带来了持续岭回归中所不存在的困难：递归地复用 ℓ₁ 惩罚估计量会传播早期的收缩效应，并在任务间累积正则化偏差。我们提出保得分持续Lasso（SP-CL），该方法通过保留历史平方损失得分，将稀疏估计与状态传递分离开来。在平方损失下，其累积估计量能够精确恢复全历史Lasso的极小值解。当任务系数一致时，它继承了全历史的稀疏率。对于相关的任务特定系数，SP-CL 采用一种正则化的当前任务修正，该修正不会改变所传递的状态，并达到离线源辅助（截断）
tldr: 提出保得分持续Lasso（SP-CL），通过保留历史平方损失得分将稀疏估计与状态传递分离，避免了递归复用 ℓ₁ 估计量导致的正则化偏差跨任务累积，并在平方损失下精确恢复全历史Lasso解与稀疏率。
en_tdlr: Proposes Score-Preserving Continual Lasso (SP-CL), which separates sparse estimation from state transmission by preserving the historical squared-loss score, thereby avoiding the cross-task accumulation of regularization bias from recursively reusing ℓ₁-penalized estimators, and exactly recovering the full-history Lasso minimizer and sparse rate under squared loss.
